LESSON: READING 12.2.1 INTENSIVE READING- COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should we recreate characters, places, and events in our minds? 2. How can we tell the meaning of words and phrases in a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. Identify the main ideas in a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of words in a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. describe characters, ideas, or events in a text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the importance of reading comprehension in lifelong learning. ● In pairs, learners are guided to download and share texts with mental images from the texts and draw conclusions. ● Learners are guided to read a passage and identify keywords in the passage. ● Learners are guided to infer the meaning of words using contextual clues. ● Learners are guided to choose a descriptive part of the passage on traditional fashion and share the vivid images created in their mind. ● In groups, learners are guided to role-play the characters and events in the text. ● Learners are guided to use contextual clues to decipher the meaning of words. 1. How can we tell the meaning of words and phrases in a text? 130 ● Learners are guided to answer questions based on the passage. ● Learners are guided to give an appropriate title to a story or passage.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Intensive Reading- Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: A learner visualise characters, events, and places.

● Creativity and Imagination: A learner gains new perspectives as they use contextual clues to infer the meanings of

words.

Values:
Responsibility: A learner helps each other to role-play characters, events and answer questions.

Link to other subjects:

Making inferences and visualising are important skills in Mathematics, Sciences, and Performing Arts
